//: Input to tools/gen-image.py. Every entry needs `claims` and `omits` before
it can be accepted; check-data.py refuses a made picture without them.
This pack sets allowPhoto true, and it is the only one that does. The rule
it relaxes exists because a photographic plate reads as a RECORD, and for
a subject that predates photography there is no record for it to be
mistaken for. A hillside in October is a present-day thing that
photographs, so photographing it asserts nothing false.
The text rule does NOT relax, and this is the pack it was written for. No
labels, no capsules, no appellation bands, no producer names, no signage.
An invented battle is an illustration; an invented Barolo label is a
forgery, because a label is a legal instrument naming a producer and a
protected origin. Bottles are shot unlabelled, from behind, or cropped.
And nothing here claims a VARIETY. The spike generated a beautiful bunch
of grapes that is not Nebbiolo, and no prompt can fix that: the model
cannot tell Nebbiolo from Barbera from Sangiovese. So the grape pictures
say 'dark grapes' in their claims and say so again in their omits. A
varietal close-up, if this course ever needs one, has to be archive.

langhe-take.prompt: rolling vineyard hills in autumn under a sea of low morning fog, only the tops of the ridges showing above the mist, bare rows of vines on the slopes, soft grey light just after sunrise, no buildings in the foreground
langhe-take.style: natural light landscape photograph, muted colour, shallow atmosphere haze

title.en: Fog over the hills in autumn

langhe-take.claims: Rolling hill country under autumn morning fog, of the kind that fills the valleys of north-west Italy in October.
langhe-take.omits: Not a photograph of any identified hill, village or vineyard. No place is being named.

vinmark-helling.prompt: steep terraced vineyard rows in late autumn colour, orange and yellow leaves, dry chalky pale soil between the rows, the slope falling away to a misty valley, low afternoon sun
vinmark-helling.style: natural light landscape photograph, muted colour
vinmark-helling.claims: Vines planted in rows on a steep slope with pale chalky soil, in autumn leaf.
vinmark-helling.omits: Not a named vineyard and not a named region. The variety of vine is not identifiable and is not claimed.

kjeller-fat.prompt: a dim cellar with very large old oak barrels standing in a row, iron hoops, packed earth floor, one shaft of light from a small high window, dust in the air, no people
kjeller-fat.style: natural light interior photograph, warm shadow, shallow depth of field
kjeller-fat.claims: Large wooden casks in an old cellar, the traditional vessel for long ageing.
kjeller-fat.omits: Not any particular producer's cellar. Nothing in frame identifies an estate.

glass-blek-rod.prompt: a single stemmed wine glass holding a small amount of pale garnet red wine, held against a plain bright window, the rim of the wine showing orange, plain grey background, nothing else on the table
glass-blek-rod.style: natural light still life photograph, shallow depth of field, muted colour
glass-blek-rod.claims: A glass of pale garnet-red wine showing an orange rim, which is what a well-aged red of this type looks like.
glass-blek-rod.omits: No bottle and no label, so no wine, producer or vintage is being identified. The colour is typical, not a measurement.

druer-kasse.prompt: dark blue-black wine grapes in a shallow wooden picking crate, dusty bloom on the skins, a few green leaves among them, resting on soil at the end of a vine row, overcast daylight
druer-kasse.style: natural light photograph, shallow depth of field, muted colour
druer-kasse.claims: Dark wine grapes in a picking crate at harvest, with the natural bloom on the skins.
druer-kasse.omits: NOT a variety. The model cannot tell Nebbiolo from Barbera from Sangiovese, and nothing here should be read as identifying which grape this is.

bord-middag.claims: An everyday table with wine served from a plain carafe, which is how the local red is usually drunk at home.
bord-middag.omits: No bottle and no label, so no wine is identified. The dish is generic and is not a named regional recipe.

alpene-over.prompt: high snow-covered alpine peaks rising behind low green foothills, clear cold air, the snowline sharp against bare rock, small terraced fields far below in shadow
alpene-over.style: natural light photograph, muted colour, shallow depth of field
alpene-over.claims: High snow-covered mountains standing over lower cultivated foothills.
alpene-over.omits: Not an identified peak, valley or country. The terrain is generic mountain country.

dal-avstengt.prompt: a narrow steep-sided valley in low cloud, one thin road winding along the floor, dense forest on both walls, no cars, no people, cool grey light
dal-avstengt.style: natural light photograph, muted colour, shallow depth of field
dal-avstengt.claims: A narrow steep valley with a single road, the kind of terrain that isolated communities from each other.
dal-avstengt.omits: Not a named valley and not a named country. Nothing here dates the scene.

gammel-stokk.prompt: the gnarled twisted trunk of a very old grapevine close up, thick rough bark, one green shoot coming from it, dry pale stony ground behind, low side light
gammel-stokk.style: natural light photograph, muted colour, shallow depth of field

gammel-stokk.omits: NOT a variety, and not an age. The model cannot distinguish one vine species from another and nothing here should be read as identifying the grape.

hender-host.prompt: two hands cutting a bunch of dark grapes from a vine with small curved shears, seen close over the shoulder, leaves around, no face in frame, morning light
hender-host.style: natural light photograph, muted colour, shallow depth of field

flasker-liggende.prompt: rows of dusty dark green wine bottles lying on their sides in a stone cellar rack, seen end on so only the bases face the camera, thick dust, dim light, no paper on the glass
flasker-liggende.style: natural light photograph, muted colour, shallow depth of field

glass-perler.style: natural light photograph, muted colour, shallow depth of field
